Carbon monoxide (CO) is an odorless, colorless gas that kills without warning. It claims the lives of hundreds of people every year and makes thousands more ill. Many household items including gas- and oil-burning furnaces, portable generators, and charcoal grills produce this poison gas. Following these important steps can keep your family safe. CO DETECTORS • Install battery-operated or battery back-up CO detectors near every sleeping area in your home. • Check CO detectors regularly to be sure they are functioning properly. OIL & GAS FURNACES • Have your furnace inspected every year. PORTABLE GENERATORS • Never use a generator inside your home or garage, even if doors and windows are open. • Only use generators outside, more than 20 feet away from your home, doors, and windows. 预防指南： 您可以防止接触一氧化碳 • 务 必每年请合格的技术人员维修您的供暖系统、热水器和任何其他燃 气、燃油或燃煤设备。 • 务 必在家中安装电池供电的一氧化碳检测器，在您每年春季和秋季更改 时钟上的时间时，检查或更换电池。如果检测器发出警报，请立即离开 家并致电 911。 • 务 必在您怀疑自己一氧化碳中毒并感觉头晕、眩晕或恶心的情况下立即 就医。 • 请 勿在家中、地下室、或车库内或窗户附近使用发电机、炭火烤架、野 营用炉或燃油或烧炭装置。 • 请 勿在您家的附建式车库里驾驶汽车或卡车，即使您将车库门保持开放 也不可以。 • 请 勿在不通风的炉子或壁炉中燃烧任何东西。 • 请 勿用煤气炉为您的房子取暖。 • 请 勿在距离任何窗户、门或通风口 20 英尺以内的位置使用发电机、压 力清洗机，或任何汽油发动机。使用一根超过 20 英尺长的延长线将您 的发电机保持在安全距离。 after using the toilet WASH YOUR HANDS 1,000,000,000,000 germs can live in one gram of poop (That’s the weight of a paper clip!) 全国环境健康中心 (National Center for Environmental Health) 环境危害和健康影响部 (Division of Environmental Hazards and Health Effects) CS283134-D August 29, 2017
